authorityBoundaries.resourceMarket: Provider registry, matching, reservation, metering and local lifecycle evidence are owned by product 16.
authorityBoundaries.walletAuth: Identity, authorization approval, product session, introspection, expiry and revocation are owned by product 02.
authorityBoundaries.chainSettlement: Asset movement, transaction finality and settlement receipt authority are owned by product 01 and accepted only through an explicitly authorized settlement identity.
authorityBoundaries.billingLedger: Canonical billing events and economic reconciliation are owned by product 26.
authorityBoundaries.publicEvidence: Explorer proof is owned by product 12, Monitor operational evidence by product 13, Trust appeal by product 15, public entry and SEO by product 28, and protocol freeze by product 29.
authorityBoundaries.assetBoundary: Resource Market never holds private keys, signs asset transfers, changes asset ownership or treats quote, capacity reservation, service start, usage or webhook status as settlement.

signedIntent.replay: reject and persist proof consumption before forwarding

api.jsonPolicy: exactly one JSON object, unknown fields rejected

truthRules: accepted intent is not capacity reservation
capacity reservation is not service start
service start or metering is not service completion
service completion is not asset settlement
asset settlement requires authoritative transaction evidence and exact signed-meter reconciliation
one transaction hash may be consumed by at most one receipt until an explicit batch-settlement contract is frozen
provider failure does not fabricate a refund or settlement
fixed-price and auction procurement reject provider self-dealing
capacity reservation is scoped to the exact offer referenced by the accepted quote
quote, auction, metering, settlement and dispute amounts use checked non-negative int64 arithmetic and fail before mutation on overflow

usageWindowRules: starts at or after evidenced service start
cumulative quantity does not exceed ordered units
cumulative protocol-fee allocation preserves quote rounding

errorCodes.RESOURCE_REQUEST_REJECTED: Generic fail-closed request rejection outside a more specific market action.
errorCodes.RESOURCE_ROLE_REQUIRED: The canonical product session lacks the exact operator role.
errorCodes.RESOURCE_SELF_DEALING_REJECTED: A provider attempted to purchase or bid on its own capacity.
errorCodes.RESOURCE_AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE: A quote, fee, usage, settlement or dispute calculation exceeds the supported non-negative signed 64-bit range.
errorCodes.RESOURCE_ACTION_REJECTED: The requested action violates a product invariant or required evidence is absent.
errorCodes.RESOURCE_CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE: Verified unreserved capacity is insufficient or capacity evidence is invalid.
errorCodes.RESOURCE_STATE_TRANSITION_INVALID: The requested transition does not match the current authoritative local lifecycle state.
errorCodes.RESOURCE_METER_WINDOW_INVALID: The usage interval predates evidenced service start, overlaps accepted usage or has incomplete lineage.
errorCodes.RESOURCE_METER_LIMIT: Cumulative signed usage or fee lineage exceeds the ordered boundary.
errorCodes.RESOURCE_PROOF_REJECTED: A replayed, tampered, expired, revoked or mismatched proof was rejected.
errorCodes.RESOURCE_SETTLEMENT_STATE_INVALID: Settlement was requested outside the completed-service and settlement-pending sequence.
errorCodes.RESOURCE_SETTLEMENT_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: Authoritative settlement identity, asset, transaction, source or evidence is absent.
errorCodes.RESOURCE_SETTLEMENT_RECONCILIATION: Receipt amounts do not exactly reconcile to signed metering.
errorCodes.RESOURCE_SETTLEMENT_REPLAY: The transaction hash was already consumed by another receipt.

healthVersion.health: GET /health returns process-local readiness only and must not claim central, public or settlement health.
healthVersion.version: GET /version returns service version, market schema version and release class.
healthVersion.status: GET /status returns current-process SLO guardrails with explicit coverage.
healthVersion.metrics: GET /metrics returns in-process counters with request and trace correlation.

migration.rollback: restore only an integrity-verified supported schema backup
migration.oldClient: unknown JSON fields and legacy Wallet headers are rejected; legacy auth routes return HTTP 410

dependencies.required: authoritative transaction finality and settlement receipt
registry, challenge, completion, introspection and revocation
provider, settlement, SLO and incident evidence
canonical billing and usage ledger events
public microsite, status, support and SEO entry
contract freeze and shared Testnet acceptance
release, artifact, backup and security acceptance

externalInputs: central Wallet/Gateway merge and deployed origin
authoritative chain settlement endpoint and Testnet funding
at least two independently operated provider endpoints
production signing assets and store accounts when applicable
professional legal review and provider agreements
